name: How long does a metal roof typically last compared to other roofing types?

mainEntity.name: How long does a metal roof typically last compared to other roofing types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofs are known for their exceptional longevity, often lasting 40-70 years, significantly longer than traditional asphalt shingle roofs, which typically last 15-30 years. This extended lifespan contributes to a lower lifecycle cost over time. When considering a metal roof for your property in areas like Allen or Addison, the long-term durability means less frequent replacement, reducing future material and labor expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs typically last 40-70 years, which is much longer than asphalt shingles (15-30 years). This provides a lower lifecycle cost.
